name: Suzaka (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Suzaka city emblem in red: an outlined hexagonal device of interlocking strokes enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Suzaka, a city in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 April 1954; the emblem dates from 1 November 1915.

features.role: Suzaka city emblem — an outlined hexagonal device of interlocking strokes enclosing a ring
